title: Derived model factorization of an underived affine unit comparison
statement: Let R,B be commutative rings and g:Spec B to Spec R a morphism. Let v and r be the ordinary and derived sections/direct-image comparison isomorphisms of [def-pc-affine-global-hom-base-change-map], and assume r satisfies the exact right-derived-unit equation hr of lean.statement. Let c:T_R Gamma_R E to T_R P Gamma_B be any natural transformation, where E is ordinary extension of scalars, P is fixed tensor pullback, and T_R is associated sheaf. Assume the ordinary extension-adjunction transpose of c_N is Gamma_R of the tensor-pullback unit at T_R(N) followed by v, for every R-module N. For any K-flat cochain complex M of R-modules [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], put Q=Q(T_R M). There are source and target comparison isomorphisms a and b from derived extension of derived R-sections of Q to Q((T_R Gamma_R E)(M)), and from derived B-sections of Lg*Q to Q((T_R P Gamma_B)(M)), respectively. They satisfy n b = a Q(c_M), where n is the transpose of Gamma_R(unit_g(Q)) r under the fixed derived extension adjunction. No invertibility of c is assumed or concluded; the statement computes this arbitrary underived comparison on K-flat models. All functors and the full equation are in lean.statement.

proof.text: Exact tilde takes the given K-flat M to a K-flat sheaf complex. Its tensor pullback is naturally termwise B-tilde of E(M). The canonical derived pullback counit on tilde M and the extension counit on M are invertible; the tilde/sections units identify ordinary sections of tilde M with M and hence also give a K-flat model for its sections.

The ordinary-to-derived sections comparison is invertible on an arbitrary complex of associated sheaves. Apply it over R to tilde M and over B to the tensor pullback model, using the preceding termwise tilde isomorphism. Compose with the K-flat extension and pullback counits and the quotient/homotopy comparison isomorphisms. This constructs a and b with the displayed endpoints. Explicitly, for K=T_R M, X=Gamma_R K and N=P K, let s_R:Q(X) to RGamma_R(Q(K)) and s_B:Q(Gamma_B N) to RGamma_B(Q(N)) be these comparisons. Write e_E and e_P for the extension and pullback left-derived counits. After the unit-compatible uniqueness identification of the fixed extension adjoint, set a=(LE(s_R))^{-1} e_E and b=RGamma_B(e_P) s_B^{-1}. The ordinary tilde unit identifies X with M, so e_E is invertible. Transport g to Spec of its coordinate ring map by full faithfulness of Spec before applying the cited tensor-pullback/tilde theorem.

Apply hc degreewise and localize it. The derived adjunction unit factorization derivedη_fac_app identifies each derived unit with its ordinary homotopy unit and the corresponding left-derived counit and right-derived unit. The canonical pullback adjunction uses these fixed normalized comparisons. The extension adjunction is identified with the derived extension/restriction adjunction by uniqueness of left adjoints; include this identification in a. Substitute the two factorizations into localized hc. Naturality moves the sections-unit comparison past the pullback counit, and hr replaces the derived lift of v by the supplied r. Cancel the invertible counit and sections comparisons to obtain n b = a Q(c_M).

theorem exists_affineExtensionSections_model_factorization
    {R B : CommRingCat.{u}} (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec R)
    (v : RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙
        affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R)) ≅
      affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)) ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g))
    (r : schemeDerivedDirectImage g ⋙ affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R)) ≅
      affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)) ⋙
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).mapDerivedCategory)
    (hr : ∀ J : HomotopyCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
      (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompUnit
          (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom)
          (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R)))).app J ≫
        (affineGlobalSectionsDerivedIso (𝟙 (Spec R))).hom.app
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J)) ≫
        r.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J) =
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((v.hom.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).app J) ≫
        (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)) ⋙
          ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app J ≫
        (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso
            (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)))
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)) ≪≫
          Functor.isoWhiskerRight (affineGlobalSectionsDerivedIso (𝟙 (Spec B)))
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).mapDerivedCategory).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J))
    (c : (@id (ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace))
        (tilde.functor R)) ⋙ affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R)) ⋙
        ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} (affineBaseRingMap g) ⟶
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace))
        (tilde.functor R)) ⋙ (@id (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g)) ⋙
        affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)))
    (hc : ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} R,
      (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (affineBaseRingMap g)).unit.app
          ((affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).obj ((tilde.functor R).obj N)) ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).map (c.app N) =
      (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).map
          ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).unit.app
            ((tilde.functor R).obj N)) ≫
        v.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj ((tilde.functor R).obj N)))
    [(@id (ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace))
        (tilde.functor R)).Additive]
    [(ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).Additive]
    [(@id (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g)).Additive]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (hM : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat M) :
    let T := @Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace))
        (tilde.functor R)) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)
    let Q := DerivedCategory.Q.obj (T.obj M)
    ∃ (a : (affineDerivedExtension g).obj
          ((affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).obj Q) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((((@id (ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace))
        (tilde.functor R)) ⋙ affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R)) ⋙
          ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj M))
      (b : (affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B))).obj ((derivedPullback g).obj Q) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((((@id (ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace))
        (tilde.functor R)) ⋙ (@id (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g)) ⋙
          affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)),
      (((affineDerivedExtensionAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).map
            ((canonicalPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app Q) ≫
          r.hom.app ((derivedPullback g).obj Q))) ≫ b.hom =
        a.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ((c.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).app M)
